title: ATP trust proof (section 4.2, v1.0.0-rc1 wire form)
description: Structural schema for the ATP trust proof, derived from section 4.2 with the atp-conformance fixtures as ground truth. Shape only: the signature covers the pipe-delimited seven-field canonical form of section 4.3, a byte rule the verifier enforces. scanSummary is an ATX v1.1 field (section 4.6), signed only inside the ATX credential's JCS(TBS); slsaLevel is illustrative and signed nowhere (section 4.2). Neither is part of the rc1 canonical form.

trustLevel.description: Section 4.1 level. A value written with a zero fraction (4.0) is the integer 4 and is accepted; the section 4.3 canonical string writes the integer in decimal digits (4), never with a fraction.

trustScore.description: 0.0-1.0 scale; formatted %.6f inside the section 4.3 canonical string.

slsaLevel.description: Illustrative (section 4.2); signed nowhere and not covered by the rc1 canonical form.

scanSummary.description: ATX v1.1 (section 4.6); signed in the ATX credential's JCS(TBS), not covered by the rc1 canonical form.
